title: Bus Position Payload (v1.0.0)
description: Position of a bus along the corridor. Published every 5 s per active bus. Position is stored as distance along the corridor in meters, without geometry (turn 1).

bus_id.description: Vehicle identifier. B-101 to B-107 run in service; B-108 to B-111 are reserve buses.

trip_id.description: Trip identifier on the standard route.

direction.description: Travel direction. Turn 1 supports direction 1 only (station -> neighborhood).

distance_along_m.description: Distance along the corridor from the origin, in meters. No geometry in turn 1.

schedule_deviation_s.description: Deviation from the schedule in seconds. Negative = early, positive = late.

doors_open.description: Whether the bus doors are open.

occupancy.description: Number of passengers on board. Bus capacity is 40. The OMD models occupancy as a 0.0-1.0 ratio; turn 1 uses the absolute count; see ADR-0002 open points.
